definitions.cluster: world_id; training seed and repeated family rows are averaged within world before bootstrap
definitions.gold_operation_conditional_exact_probabi: posterior probability of the exact target binding conditional on the gold operation
definitions.hierarchical_exact: operation marginal argmax, then top binding candidate within that selected operation
definitions.operation_marginal_correct: argmax of candidate probability summed over all bindings of each allowed operation
definitions.oracle_gold_operation_pointer_exact: top candidate after restricting to the gold operation; not served performance

interpretation: saved-posterior offline oracle diagnostic; no model inference or training
